title: Add comprehensive API documentation
overview:
API components exist but lack documentation, making integration difficult.

**Motivation:** Enables users to understand and integrate with the API effectively.

**Signals:** priority: low
problem_statement: API components exist but lack documentation, making integration difficult.
motivation: Enables users to understand and integrate with the API effectively.
resolution_notes: Already implemented. docs/API.md exists with comprehensive API documentation including: Overview with current state and architecture, Quick Start guide with build/run instructions, Endpoints Reference, Testing examples, Building from Source guide, and more. The API server is well-documented for users who want to integrate with it.
